lemma mountain (he:Note C.S (R) (-1))(hp:W.Derivatives S)(j:ℕ→ℕ)(s:ℝ)(hs:1<s) (hj:Tendsto j atTop atTop) (hJ:Tendsto (fun i:ℕ=>C.S.scale (j i)/C.S.scale i) atTop (𝓝 s))(B:ℕ): ∃ D:ℕ, ∀ ε:ℝ,0<ε→∀ᶠ m in atTop,∀ j':Axis,∀ x:E4,(∀ t∈Icc (-arm D) (arm D), chord j' x (C.S.a (j m)) t∈ arena ((R) m))→
    ∃ z: ℕ→ℝ→ℂ, z 0=district q X w g B m ∘ chord j' x (C.S.a (j m)) ∧ (∀ i<D,∀ t∈Icc (-arm D) (arm D),HasDerivAt (z i) (z (i+1) t) t) ∧ ∀ t∈Icc (-arm D) (arm D), ‖z D t‖ ≤ ε :=by

proof_context.conclusion: `mountain` builds the chain of derivatives `z i` of `district` along grid-sized chords, each `HasDerivAt`, with `‖z D t‖ ≤ ε` eventually.

lemma beneath (he:Note C.S (R) (-1)) (hC:C.Makes)(hq:Cells.CellHyp C F)(ho:F.PointLimits C S)(H:S.Hierarchy) (t:ℝ)(j:ℕ→ℕ) (hj:Tendsto j atTop atTop)(hJ:Tendsto (fun i:ℕ=>C.S.scale (j i)/C.S.scale i) atTop (𝓝 t)) (hp: q.fst+2+(Clouds (C:=C) (expose ∘ w):ℝ)<(D:ℝ)*t) {ε:ℝ}(hE:0<ε):
   ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ y∈arena ((R) i), (C.S.a (j i))^D * ‖disc (Fin.cons (α:=fun _=>S.Tag) q w) (Points.cons y I.held)‖ ≤ ε:=by

proof_context.conclusion: `beneath` bounds `a^D * ‖disc (cons q w) (cons y held)‖` by `ε` when `q.fst + 2 + Clouds < D*t`, the one-insertion bound with exponent loss two.
